articles.headline: USMNT faces World Cup dilemma vs. Turkiye: Rotate squad or keep same XI?
articles.description: The USMNT has clinched a spot in the World Cup knockouts, so should the team rotate in its final Group D match or stay consistent?

articles.headline: Resolving the Jordan Ayew dilemma and other areas of focus for Ghana vs. England
articles.description: Ghana and England have met only once before at senior level - a 1-1 friendly draw at Wembley in March 2011. Tuesday's match marks their first competitive meeting.

articles.headline: World Cup Daily: Crying Belgium fan saved by VAR; Messi, Mbappé, Haaland in action
articles.description: It's another week of 2026 FIFA World Cup action, and we have some big teams playing today, including Argentina, France and Norway.

articles.headline: Mohamed Salah pleased 'to make the people happy' after Egypt's first World Cup win
articles.description: Mohamed Salah has spoken of his pride at the chance "to make the people happy in Egypt" after his team beat New Zealand 3-1 to claim the nation's first ever World Cup win.

articles.headline: Marcus Rashford: England must bring 'intensity that Ghana can't live with' at World Cup
articles.description: Marcus Rashford has called for unrelenting intensity that Ghana "can't live with" as England look to book their place in the World Cup knockout stages with a game to spare.

articles.headline: Kylian Mbappé: I knew Lionel Messi would keep scoring goals at World Cup
articles.description: Kylian Mbappé is hot on the heels of the player he calls "the best," Lionel Messi, to become the top scorer in men's World Cup history.
